title: Announce a local kill
description: Route the normalized event. count may be greater than one when several kills arrive in one update; it is not a victim list.

title: Ace to delayed secret-case giveaway
description: For 5v5, an ace means at least five observed local round kills. In Wingman, choose a different threshold instead of claiming a two-kill round is a five-player ace. Configure secret_case with is_visible=false and is_paused=false. This example requires three messages and 15 characters in the previous five minutes plus one completed entry_reward redemption in seven days; remove the reward predicate for an open giveaway. Stable winner job key replaces an earlier pending giveaway, not already queued work. Reward triggers are never automatically announced or retried.

title: Open a reward temporarily
description: enable_for persists an internal reversal and needs no on_timer. Disabling the project blocks the hide, so review outstanding jobs before disabling. This only changes visibility, not pause.

title: Schedule and route one-shot work
description: Jobs retain their creating revision. This explicit hide timer requires on_timer and is useful when you need to store your own payload. exists includes blocked/queued jobs; cancel cannot stop already queued/running work.

title: Keep persistent counters
description: Project storage survives revisions and restarts. increment is atomic; multiple calls are not one transaction. Dry run changes only its private overlay.

title: Choose a recent eligible chatter
description: Use query-time activity, not an event timestamp or guessed Twitch subscription state. random.pick returns () on empty arrays. user_stats redemptions covers the same window but does not prove completed Steam delivery.

title: Filter by reward history
description: Both activity and redemption criteria must pass. min_count(0), the default, disables the redemption predicate. Empty statuses means all statuses; the redemption window is independent of the chat window.

title: Trigger a hidden reward without failure spam
description: Set script_alias=secret_case, visibility off, operational pause off, and ensure the bot/reward is active. Visibility does not prevent script-trigger. An unsuccessful result may include a fulfillment/inventory ID. Never retry an ambiguous result automatically.

title: Inspect a recent round streak safely
description: An observed index is zero-based, not a guarantee that every real round was captured. Null sides/winners break the streak check rather than being filled with guesses; a CT/T relabel is not a score gain.

title: A project with event and timer modules
description: Imports resolve from the project root, including inside a module. Moving events/kills.rhai does not rewrite the main import. Save then Validate catches missing imports and even broken orphan files.
